name: Pulses Mk II

modulargrid.listedAs: Music Thing Modular Pulses Mk II

source: Pulses v2 panel artwork (github.com/TomWhitwell/Turing-Pulse-Expander, Collateral/Pulses v2 Panel/Pulses_v2_Panel artwork.pdf); https://www.musicthing.co.uk/Turing-Pulse-Expander/; ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026)
notes: 11 gate outputs, each with LED. 1-7 are the individual shift-register bits; the four combination outputs fire when all listed steps are high (BOM uses a 4081 quad AND gate; musicthing: 'when steps 1+2 are active, the 1+2 output pulses'). Labels taken from the v2 open-source panel artwork; the Thonk Mk II production panel is assumed to match but was not seen. Rear ribbon header not listed.
